author: danceratopz
content:
Please add your topics to [Monday's ACDT agenda](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2299)!

Heads up that a significant part of Monday's ACDT will focus on EIP-8037 and the Glamsterdam repricings. There will be an update on the ongoing investigations into contract behavior, followed by an open Q&A. App devs are encouraged to join and participate!

Incidentally, the call has been extended from 60 to 90 minutes, and this will be the new duration for future calls as well.
